_comment: HAND-AUTHORED. Never script-written. Extracted from cv/onepage/ONE-PAGE.tex L208-213.
`amount` is the single source of the money. The funding total that both CVs and the
site print is the sum of these amounts (scripts/lib/derive.js fundingTotal); the
one-pager reaches it through the `\funding` macro named by `amountMacro`, and the
biosketch prints each award's own amount. Never type the figure anywhere else.
`objectives` is printed under the award in the biosketch. Ids are referenced as

awards.title: Funding for Climate Solutions
awards.location: Funding for Climate Solutions, Woodwell Climate Research Center
awards.project: A Generic Climate AI Framework for Multi-domain Time Series Prediction
awards.objectives: This project will attempt to develop a generic climate AI framework that will unify and accelerate time-series inferences across Woodwell Climate Research Center's diverse research domains, from Arctic carbon fluxes to tropical forest dynamics.
